newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Stals sees rand stabilising at lows.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Stals sees rand stabilising at lows.

text.p: Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals said on Friday the rand had over-reacted to economic fundamentals but was unlikely to recover significantly, instead holding relatively stable at current weak levels for some time.

"I don't think the exchange rate will come down (appreciate) to the fundamentals. I think the exchange rate will remain relatively stable for some time," he said in response to questions after addressing a conference here.

Stals said an annual depreciation in the rand of about five percent was neutral given the average inflation rate of South Africa's major trading partners was some three percent compared to South Africa's eight percent.
But the 20 percent fall in the currency's trade weighted value this year was an over-reaction, even allowing for last year's unjustified appreciation.
"A five percent depreciation of the exchange rate per annum is neutral...it does not change the competitiveness of South African industries," Stals said.
